title: Matrix 2.0 — How we're making Matrix go voom!
summary: A FOSDEM 2023 talk from the Matrix team on Matrix 2.0, covering sliding sync, the Element X client rewrite and next-generation calling. It explains how Matrix aims to match the speed of proprietary messengers.
why: HN threads link it as the primary source for Matrix's performance claims and sliding sync improvements.

quote.text: we revealed the end result at FOSDEM a few weeks ago, and it literally improves performance to be better than Telegram/Discord/Slack
